modules.name: Facilities
modules.description: Lets residents view shared facilities (gym, pool) with live count and free slots, book slots, and check in and out.

requirements.title: Show facilities with live count and free slots
requirements.description: Residents open Facilities and see each facility with its live count (for example "12 inside / 30 capacity") and free slots.

requirements.title: Book date and slot for facilities
requirements.description: When a facility needs booking, the resident picks a date and slot, and the booking is made if the slot has space.

requirements.title: Check In with family member count
requirements.description: On arrival the resident taps Check In and adds how many family members came along.

requirements.title: Live count rises on check-in
requirements.description: On check-in the live count goes up and is visible to everyone in the project.

requirements.title: Check Out lowers live count
requirements.description: On leaving, the resident taps Check Out and the live count goes down.

requirements.title: Show next free slots when slot is full
requirements.description: If the chosen slot is full, the system shows the next free slots.

requirements.title: Automatic check-out for forgotten check-outs
requirements.description: If a resident forgets to check out, the system checks them out automatically at slot end or closing time.

requirements.title: Notify booked users of maintenance closure
requirements.description: When a facility is marked closed for maintenance, users who have booked are notified.

rules.title: Block check-in at capacity
rules.description: When a facility is at capacity, check-in is blocked and a message is shown.

rules.title: Free unused booked slots after set minutes
rules.description: If a resident booked but did not come, the slot is freed after a set number of minutes, which Raghuvir Admin sets.

rules.title: Only Approve bookings members can close facility
rules.description: A member with the Approve bookings permission marks a facility closed for maintenance.
